rule_decisions.outcome: adopt=true. Primary endpoint met: hold-out all-pass difference +0.0707, CI95 [0.0625, 0.0794] (paired by task, function-clustered bootstrap, 2,000 resamples). Secondaries all pass: mean reward difference +0.0648 [0.0564, 0.0739]; exact match difference +0.0726 [0.0643, 0.0817]; DEV250 score250 110 >= 105 (start 109, bar = 109 - 4); CPT 2K rise -0.0272 <= 0.03 (below start: the CPT replay fully controlled forgetting). Consequence: C18b checkpoint 200 (/mnt/e/sepalith/campaign-20260915/checkpoints/C18b-grpo-exec-pilot-1/full/checkpoint-200) is ADOPTED as the campaign's best model, superseding C18 checkpoint 100. Ladder on the same frozen hold-out, all-pass: 803 0.310 -> C18 u100 0.355 -> C18b u200 0.381. Open signal for the next card: DEV75 nofp rose 9->13 over 200 updates (rollback band at 200) while everything else improved; next-step design is not part of this PR. Results note: docs/training/plan-20260927/c18b/RESULTS.md

notes: Built, smoke-ready and pre-registered; nothing enqueued, no GPU used. The PR is based on feat/exec-eval-jobs, so it also carries PR #91 (exec env) and the exec-eval job commits. A worktree-rooted smoke (C18-grpo-exec-smoke-worktree) lets the coordinator run the smoke before the merge; the main-rooted recipes and jobs stay for after the merge (the pilot still requires C18-grpo-exec-smoke). 2026-10-29: pilot ended by user stop at update 100 (CPT 2K rise 0.0238, stop band); the pre-registered final hold-out verdict is adopt=true (all-pass +0.0455 [0.038, 0.0528]), checkpoint 100 adopted over arm A 803 as the campaign's best model; C18b pre-registered in PR #94, not launched. Verdict note: docs/training/plan-20260927/c18/RESULTS.md. 2026-10-30: C18b pilot ended by user stop at update 200 (nofp_rise 4, rollback band; CPT NLL below start at every gate); the pre-registered final hold-out verdict is adopt=true (all-pass +0.0707 [0.0625, 0.0794] over arm A 803), C18b checkpoint 200 adopted as the campaign's best model, superseding C18 checkpoint 100 (hold-out all-pass ladder 803 0.310 -> C18 0.355 -> C18b 0.381). Verdict note: docs/training/plan-20260927/c18b/RESULTS.md.
